svg.aria-label: Skills: Full-stack web apps — React + TypeScript frontends, APIs in Go, Flask, FastAPI (Airport, TODO App, MixGame, SonSatır); Security & auth — Password hashing, role-based access, HttpOnly sessions (Airport Flight Management, SonSatır); Database design — PostgreSQL migrations, schema design, SQL (Airport Flight Management, SonSatır); Docker & Linux — Docker Compose, multi-stage Dockerfiles, WSL2 (); C / C++ — C++17 with Raylib and CMake, OOP and data structures (ADAS Parking Simulation, data structures coursework); Machine learning — Regression, classification, neural networks (Deep Learning course (scikit-learn, Keras)); CI & testing — GitHub Actions, pytest, JUnit, go test (SonSatır, MixGame, Airport, Java Task Manager); Reports & diagrams — LaTeX reports and UML diagrams (draw.io and TikZ: use case, activity, class, sequence). Spoken languages: Turkish (native) · English.
